source._version_note: v3.6.12 LIVE-VERIFIED on <redacted: internal host> (clone --depth 1 --branch v3.6.12). Version symbol Version="3.6.12" is HARDCODED in api/version/version.go; only go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/version.GitSHA is injected via -ldflags (=90b034a). MULTI-MODULE: 7 modules (root `.`=go.etcd.io/etcd/v3 + api, pkg, client/pkg, client/v3, server, etcdctl, etcdutl, tests) wired by `replace` directives in the ROOT go.mod (replace go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3 => ./server, etc.). The product binaries live in SUB-modules, NOT the root — `go build ./server` from the repo root FAILS. TOOLCHAIN: .go-version=1.25.10, go.mod `go 1.25.0` + `toolchain go1.25.10`; with default GOTOOLCHAIN=auto, Go 1.26 would DOWNLOAD go1.25.10 over the network (breaks --network=none). MUST set GOTOOLCHAIN=local so the container's go1.26.4 (satisfies go>=1.25.0) compiles — verified. GOWORK=off is a harmless no-op here (no go.work); the relevant handling is 'cd into the module dir'.
source._no_vendor_build_note: etcd ships NO web UI / dashboard / embedded frontend (zero go:embed of assets) — a plain per-module `go build .` produces a complete server. NO Node/npm asset step; source.vendor_build is intentionally OMITTED (null).
source._offline_vendor_note: HERMETIC/OFFLINE VENDOR GAP (highest risk): dep_bumps + `go mod tidy -e` + `go mod vendor` MUST run PER binary sub-module (from inside ./server, ./etcdctl, ./etcdutl) — a single root `go mod vendor` (the render_l009_kit default) does NOT vendor the binary sub-modules and the --network=none offline build WILL fail. The kit-builder needs a per-module vendor loop for this product (L-A50).

binaries_from_source.name: etcd
binaries_from_source._note: PRIMARY single-binary target. Build from INSIDE its module dir: `cd ./server && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags="-s -w -X=go.etcd.io/etcd/api/v3/version.GitSHA=90b034a" -o /out/etcd .`. main_pkg `.` (server/main.go wraps go.etcd.io/etcd/etcdmain). Mirrors upstream scripts/build.sh per-module `cd && go build .`; ReadyStack adds mandatory -buildvcs=false (kills phantom 0.0.0 CVEs) + -s -w. -installsuffix=cgo (legacy no-op under CGO=0) is dropped. Verified live: 26.9 MB static stripped ELF, `etcd --version` => 3.6.12 / Git SHA 90b034a / go1.26.4 / linux/amd64.

binaries_from_source.name: etcdctl
binaries_from_source._note: Admin CLI shipped for the handbook (the sqlite3-CLI parity slot). Build from `cd ./etcdctl && go build .`. 17.8 MB static stripped ELF. Do NOT bake ETCDCTL_API=3 in ENV — removed in 3.6, emits an 'unrecognized environment variable' warning (v3 is the default).

binaries_from_source.name: etcdutl
binaries_from_source._note: Data/maintenance util (snapshot restore/defrag), optional and cheap to include. Build from `cd ./etcdutl && go build .`. 17.7 MB static stripped ELF.
